scope: Qonductor logical-input recovery; strong-agent S1-S4 handoff
authority: supplemental candidate-recovery contract; no historical eligibility or score replacement

generator.historical_version_status: candidate version, not a collection-time lock
generator.required_pipeline: get_benchmark(level=indep, compiler=qiskit), not only create_circuit/decompose; pin transitive dependencies and helper source; disclose any shim

width_rules.qft: two equal-sized registers, exactly one fully written, one unused; width = written destination count, not total classical allocation
width_rules.qaoa: source does not call measure_all; inspect actual indep/compiler/wrapper route before enabling a measurement-derived rule
width_rules.status: candidate width under pinned generator assumptions only; never automatically verified logical instance
guardrails: AST parser, no regex-only measurement/control interpretation
no reset, dynamic control or nonterminal measurement
preserve bit ordering and physical wire labels
one complete written register for measured_all/plus_one; unsupported shapes go to investigation
backend capacity is a bound only, never a width estimator

instance_policies.random: seed=10 and transpiler seed=10 in source, but basis list created from set and dependency/hash-seed context matter; no historical identity from repeatability alone
instance_policies.graphstate: unseeded random_regular_graph; width does not determine edge instance
instance_policies.qnn: unseeded ansatz parameters; source structure possible, angles unresolved
instance_policies.portfolio: unseeded random financial data and optimizer-derived angles; source structural template only unless additional instance evidence is recovered
instance_policies.qaoa_vqe: optimizer-derived angles; inspect maxcut helper graph and dependency context; no new optimization to pretend to recover historical angles
instance_policies.circuit_names: circuit-* is investigation_required, not proof of non-MQT origin

evidence.broad_screen_limit: family-level probe at widths 5/7, not row-level instance recovery
evidence.reuse_boundary: preserve historical graph schema/angle-insensitive qualification; not automatic compatibility with full-feature Ma-Li encoder

forbidden: infer source identity from gate counts or width alone
infer circuit size from classical allocation sum
strip measurements and claim unitary equivalence of original measured process
promote routine-agent results to benchmark training
validation.small_case: at most 9 logical qubits for dense semantic checks, sequential <=2 GiB task RAM and capped CPU threads; larger checks require a separate bounded design
semantic_requirements: explicit measured-wire mapping and output ordering
correct initial-state scope: fixed-input agreement is not full channel equivalence
validation.split_gate: new recipe equivalence may reveal cross-fold duplicates; report collisions; do not edit frozen splits or launch logical training
validation.preflight: at least one QASM per observed family/measurement pattern plus archived positive matches and dynamic negative case, label-free selection; record errors before bulk generation

routine_queue.task: AST-based deduplicated inventory and mapping back to all canonical Qonductor rows
reuse pinned legacy archive/recipe/materialization evidence; validate paths/hashes and encoder compatibility
apply reviewed family width rules and retain empty/multiple candidate sets
materialize generator candidates after preflight; no optimizer-based angle recovery
run bounded structural/semantic checks, preserve scope and ambiguity
write one recovery_rows.csv and manifest.json under artifacts/real_qpu/logical_recovery; aggregate coverage and leakage flags

scheduling: C1/C2 can be parallel CPU preprocessing with total <=4 threads and 4 GiB RAM while unrelated training is active; C3 follows C1, C4 follows candidate preflight, C5 follows C4, C6 joins all; no subagent permission inferred
strong_final_review: S5-S7 required before choosing new Ma-Li logical inputs/training; this contract authorizes no fitting

bounded_review.kind: read-only AST inspection, not simulation or recovered-instance validation
bounded_review.selection: smallest submitted-QASM ZIP member by bytes per selected family, ties in canonical order, no labels

observations.reason: actual QASM contains measurements absent from inspected create_circuit source; trace dependency/wrapper
meas[3] and meas0[3], six measurements repeat quantum wires; never infer width=6 or silently drop outputs

bounded_review.boundary: does not fulfill full-family/measurement-pattern routine preflight; no new recovered-observation count
